xna-type.name: BoneWeightCollection
xna-type.summary: Collection of bone weights of a vertex.
xna-type.remarks: These objects are stored in the Weights property of a vertex data channel object. The complete set of weights should sum to one.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of BoneWeightCollection.

method.name: NormalizeWeights
method.summary: Normalizes the contents of the bone weights list.

overload.summary: Normalizes the contents of the bone weights list.
overload.remarks: Normalization does the following: Sorts weights such that the most significant weight is first. Removes zero-value entries. Discards weights with the smallest value until there are maxWeights or less in the list. Adjusts values so the sum equals one. Throws InvalidContentException if all weights are zero.
